name: KromiumPermissionListener
summary: Functional interface for intercepting and deciding on media/hardware permission requests.

methods.name: onRequestPermission
methods.description: Evaluates an incoming KromiumPermissionRequest and returns a KromiumPermissionDecision.

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: Details of the requesting web frame, origin, and requested permission types.

companionMethods.name: grantAll
companionMethods.description: Creates a listener that automatically grants all media and device permission requests.

companionMethods.name: denyAll
companionMethods.description: Creates a listener that automatically denies all media and device permission requests.

companionMethods.name: forOrigins
companionMethods.description: Creates a listener that grants permissions only if the origin is explicitly allowed.

parameters.name: allowedOrigins
parameters.description: Set of allowed origin URLs or hostnames.
